title: Property of inheriting scene has no reset in inspector
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.2.2.stable.official [15073afe3], v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8], v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]
- Other versions not tested

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 11 (Windows 10.0.26100) - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.6557) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1135G7 @ 2.40GHz (8 Threads)

### Issue description

When an exported property is assigned a default value in a script, the property in the inspector should have the small reset arrow when its current value is not equal to the default.

This is not the case for properties declared in inherited scenes with extending classes.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create scene A with script `class_name A` and an exported property `a` with a default
```gdscript
class_name A extends Node
@export var a:float = 1.0
```
- Create scene B as an inherited scene from scene A, give it a script that `extends A`, and export a property `b` with a default
```gdscript
class_name B extends A
@export var b:float = 1.0
```
- From the inspector of scene B, changing property `a` will let you reset it. But changing property `b` gives no reset option, in spite of having a default

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

In this project, open up scene `test_2.tscn` and script `test2.gd`. Note that property `C` is not set to the default of `1.0` but yet it has no reset arrow.

[inherited-property-issue.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19101154/inherited-property-issue.zip)
